reason: On both states the Event types combobox carries autocomplete="garbage", a deliberate token to switch off browser autofill. The field picks webhook event types; it does not collect information about the user, so no input purpose from the 1.3.5 list applies.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG input purposes list (name, email, address and so on). Event types is a picker for webhook event names, so it serves none, and an invalid token changes nothing for any user: browsers ignore it and the accessible name (Event types) and role (combobox) are intact. 4.1.2 is not affected because autocomplete is not part of the name, role or value exposed. No other A or AA criterion covers the attribute.
